@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+---
+assignees:

+- 01M372QB7QSM58G9CSADVYT1DX
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9980'
+title: Delete the fact-retention compaction eval
+---
+## Decision (from the owner, 2026-09-23)
+
+"get rid of the fact retention eval". The fact-retention tier plants small facts and checks that a summary keeps them. The compaction prompt now keeps only the points that matter to go on (^dvyt1dx, `router-default-v6`), so that measure no longer fits. The continuity eval stays.
+
+## Do this
+
+1. Find every part of the fact-retention eval and delete it: the dataset and seeds (`Tests/FoundationModelsRouterEvalSupport/CompactionEvalDataset.swift`, `CompactionEvalSeed.swift`, `CompactionEvalRecallInstructions.swift`, `CompactionEvalFactRetentionReport.swift`, `CompactionEvaluation.swift`, `CompactionEvaluationOutcome.swift`, `CompactionEvalTiers.swift`, `CompactionEvalRealModel.swift`, `CompactionEvalProgressLog.swift` — confirm each by reading it first), the eval tests (`Tests/FoundationModelsRouterEvals/CompactionEvaluationTests.swift`, `CompactionEvalDispatchShapeTests.swift`), the gated runner (`IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterEvalIntegrationTests/CompactionEvalRealModelTests.swift`, `Support/CompactionEvalRealSubjectRunner.swift`), and any doc or README section about it.
+2. Keep everything the continuity eval uses (`CompactionContinuity*`). If a file serves both, keep the shared part and delete only the fact-retention part.
+3. Remove the targets or products from `Package.swift` / `IntegrationTests/Package.swift` only if they become empty.
+4. Do not change the compaction code, the prompt, or the continuity eval's behaviour.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- `rg -i 'fact.?retention|CompactionEvaluation|CompactionEvalDataset|CompactionEvalSeed'` finds nothing in `Sources`, `Tests`, `IntegrationTests` or docs, except the continuity eval if it shares a name (state which on the card).
+- The continuity eval still builds and its unit tests pass. All tests pass; `IntegrationTests` builds.
+
+## Order
+
+After ^dvyt1dx, which is running the continuity tier now.
+
+#compaction
\ No newline at end of file
